page_title: What is the engineering interview process like at Stripe?

summary.title: What is the engineering interview process like at Stripe?
summary.one_liner: A Quora Q&A collecting candidate and employee accounts of tech hiring at Stripe, Quora, Square, Spotify, and Exotel, mainly covering interview stages and how hiring decisions get made.
takeaways: Stripe's engineering process has three interview types: a phone screen, 45-minute chats on past experience and reasoning, and pairing interviews on real or canned problems.
Quora's onsite loop includes two technical rounds, a practical coding interview on a large codebase, a hiring manager behavioral round, and a recruiter wrap-up.

Hiring decision models differ: committee-driven (Google-style), manager-driven (Netflix-style), and Quora's hybrid where the hiring manager decides in front of interviewers, with CEO approval of offers.
Several accounts stress that interviewers value explaining reasoning and admitting unknowns over guessing, and that coding is done on a computer.
summary.summary: This Quora thread, listed in awesome-cto under Hiring, gathers several first-hand accounts rather than one authoritative guide. Stripe's section includes a Stripe employee describing three interview types (phone screen, chats, pairing) and a candidate's praise for computer-based, realistic questions. Other answers describe Quora's intern and experienced-hire loops, its hybrid hiring-decision process, and accounts from Spotify, Square, and Exotel. Much of the text is a mix of answers and the page's own repeated snippets, so the Stripe-specific facts are limited.
